limitations: This relates the identified publisher reference to one SPDX entry in the pinned release. The generated artifacts and publisher HTML remain different representations. Legal effects of earlier wording and specific grants require separate evidence.

triggers: Publisher corrects, replaces, or withdraws the displayed ISC text or separate reuse wording
The exact source capture, its original provenance, or the independent inspection route becomes unavailable
A material applicability boundary or contradiction is found for the captured reference
The SPDX annotated release tag, its target, or the source-link relationship changes.

statement: The official SPDX license-list-data annotated tag v3.29.0 points to commit 31ba1a50e5397e00a304dbadc76531740e89ee48. The ISC detail at that commit names ISC License as ISC and links to the publisher's licensing page. The crosswalk relates the publisher-displayed and/or reference to that exact SPDX entry.
